title: Heat a mug: C stuck at the stoveburner, E uses the microwave
goal: put a hot mug in cabinet.
shows: C picks the mug up and tries to put it on the stoveburner (invalid) and examines the burners for 30 steps; E goes straight to the microwave: `heat mug 1 with microwave 1`, then cabinet.
why_interesting: The clearest C-lost / E-won pattern: C never learns the `heat ... with microwave` command; E wins 8-step heat games repeatedly.
notes: Only one rule was shown (a Corrected Error about going to the target after heating); the microwave itself came from the planner. The same game with another library (check-avoid70, whose recipe names the microwave) is also won in 8 steps.
